profile.notice: Pointwise asymptotic likelihood-ratio thresholds conditional on IID Gaussian noise and fixed initialization. Grid crossing interpolation; open boundaries do not prove infinite intervals. Serial residuals and rank loss invalidate routine nominal coverage.

analytic_family.notice: Root-partition extrema of the exact equivalence class at a fixed fitted transfer function, restricted by the numerical box. These are not likelihood-confidence endpoints. Floating-point endpoint feasibility is explicitly checked.

profile.refinement_notice: Observed threshold crossings were bisected; this does not prove all modes/global minima were discovered. Original physical flat regions include independently verified feasible transfer-equivalence witnesses. Source profiles and attempts remain preserved separately.
